title: Harvest & Gears
description: A cozy vanilla+ experience focused on farming, cooking, and relaxing gameplay with Farmer's Delight.
body:
A cozy vanilla+ experience focused on farming, cooking, and relaxing gameplay with Farmer's Delight.
Grow crops, prepare hearty meals, and build a peaceful homestead at your own pace.
Light automation from Create Mod adds just a touch of creativity without taking over the experience.

If you have any tips, questions or issue you can contact us in our discord server
